builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Gangplank: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (8,310 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55.3% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A setup-heavy fighter who threatens chained keg zones, uses a global bombardment to influence fights and cleanses retaliation. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Essence Reaver → The Collector → Infinity Edge. Deathfire Touch keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Lord Dominik's Regards, Guardian Angel.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Essence Reaver → The Collector → Infinity Edge, with Deathfire Touch.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Essence Reaver → The Collector → Infinity Edge) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55.3% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Essence Reaver → The Collector → Infinity Edge.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Gangplank signals his ship to fire [12] waves of cannonballs anywhere on the map over [8] seconds. Each wave Slows by [30]% for [0.5] seconds and deals [40 / 70 / 100 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage. Maximum damage: [(40 / 70 / 100 + (0.1) × AP) × (12)]

This Ability can be upgraded in the shop via {{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}}.

Fire at Will: Fires 6 additional waves of cannonballs.
Death's Daughter: Fires a Mega-Cannonball that deals [120 / 210 / 300 + (0.3) × AP] true damage and Slows by [75]% for [1] second.
Raise Morale: Allies inside Cannon Barrage gain [40]% Move Speed for [2] seconds.

Gangplank places a powder keg that can be attacked by Gangplank and enemy champions for [25] seconds. When an enemy destroys it, the keg is defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes, Slowing by [40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80]% for [2] seconds and dealing the Attack's damage, ignoring [40]% Armor. Champions take an additional [75 / 95 / 115 / 135 / 155] physical damage.

Keg health decays every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds. Keg explosions detonate other kegs with overlapping blast zones, but don't deal damage to the same target more than once. Keg explosions triggered by {{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}} will grant the bonus gold for targets killed.
Gangplank consumes a large amount of citrus fruit, removing all Disabling effects and restoring [45 / 70 / 95 / 120 / 145 + (0.9) × AP] plus [13]% missing Health.

Gangplank's melee Attacks ignite the target, dealing an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(50 → 250; raw flags preserved) + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] true damage over [2.5] seconds and granting Gangplank [characterLevelInterpolation(0.15 → 0.3; raw flags preserved)] Move Speed for [2] seconds.

Destroying a Powder Keg refreshes this Cooldown and grants Gangplank the same Move Speed.

builds.name: Global barrage mage
builds.summary: Make global area denial the main AP payoff.
builds.goal: Make global area denial the main AP payoff.
builds.hypothesis: Cannon Barrage fires 12 magic waves with 0.1 AP each over eight seconds, with earned Fire at Will adding six waves. Malignance and Liandry reward continued ultimate contact; Deathcap increases wave damage and Remove Scurvy's 0.9 AP heal. Barrel slow can help local enemies remain inside R, but barrel damage itself remains attack-derived physical.
testPlan: Required state: Need a real choke, earned upgrades and R available for the objective fight.
Compare damage for two-, four- and eight-second R exposure, keeping upgrades identical.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Targets leave the area or local physical damage becomes too weak to defend.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The maximum twelve-wave total assumes continuous contact; global range does not guarantee it.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Malignance, Liandry's Torment, Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Gangplank: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A setup-heavy fighter who threatens chained keg zones, uses a global bombardment to influence fights and cleanses retaliation. Test real keg chains, target armor and crit outcomes. Do not assume every barrel crits; passive fire, Q and barrels have different damage/trigger rules. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Gangplank: Test real keg chains, target armor and crit outcomes. Do not assume every barrel crits; passive fire, Q and barrels have different damage/trigger rules.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Shoots target, plundering Gold for each enemy unit killed. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.

The route fails Gangplank's stated kit question: Test real keg chains, target armor and crit outcomes. Do not assume every barrel crits; passive fire, Q and barrels have different damage/trigger rules.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Trial-by-Fire endurance
builds.summary: Use barrel destruction for repeated melee true-damage burns.
builds.goal: Use barrel destruction for repeated melee true-damage burns.
builds.hypothesis: Trial by Fire's burn has an AD statFormula expression, and destroying a Powder Keg refreshes the passive and grants speed. Trinity supports a post-ability attack while Bloodmail links health to AD; Visage helps Scurvy's 13% missing-health component and Sundered Sky rewards contact. This route tests repeated melee resets rather than one crit-barrel detonation.
testPlan: Required state: Need safe barrel ownership and time to land melee burns between explosions.
Count passive burns, barrel resets and healing over a controlled eight-second melee skirmish.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Opponents defuse barrels or punish melee entry; weaker ranged bursts let them disengage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Destroying connected barrels cannot be assumed to deal multiple explosion hits to one target.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Overlord's Bloodmail, Sundered Sky, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
